secondary_signals.what_happened: Eric Criscuolo, Market Strategist at the NYSE, reviews a choppy week in which the S&P 500 slipped about 1% after a hot core CPI print sent yields sharply higher, only for a full reversal to offer equities no relief. Tech led the retreat, down roughly 4% with memory names hit hardest, as AI spending doubts and slowing growth at Anthropic fueled the bear case. A hotter PPI and a core retail sales miss then pushed 10 and 30-year yields down 15-20 basis points. Strong breadth lifted the equal-weight index as investors rotated into Staples and Healthcare, both up about 4%. Looking ahead, Meta, Tesla, IBM, SAP, and Blackstone headline a very busy earnings slate。
